admission: Candidates are periodic Voronoi partitions screened with the reference map alone in an order fixed before screening; a candidate qualifies when every grain is alive at t = 0, at least three grains go extinct within the horizon and no grain returns. The first three qualifying candidates form each regime's cohort, so the cases are extinction-bearing by construction and do not estimate performance on unselected microstructures.

criteria.admissibility: (ii) admissibility: every prescribed step is completed and every state is finite, nonnegative and has maximum unit-sum error at most 1e-12
criteria.alive_extinct_sets_and_timing: (iii) alive/extinct sets and extinction timing: the alive set equals the reference alive set at every evaluation time, the extinct set equals the reference set, every extinction step lies within max(100, 0.1 s_ref) steps of the reference step, and no extinct phase returns
criteria.field_error_relative_to_persistence: (iv) field error relative to persistence: E_TV(model) / E_TV(persistence) is at most a(s) at every evaluation time with t >= 5, with a = 0.5 and a = 0.25 at the final step
criteria.grain_volume_error: (v) grain-volume error: the maximum normalized grain-volume error is at most 0.05 at every evaluation time
criteria.structural_consistency: (i) structural consistency: permuting the phase fields commutes with one step to within 1e-15, appended zero phases stay exactly zero and leave the existing phases bitwise unchanged, and every output is finite, nonnegative and sums to one within 1e-12; assessed once per regime on fields that are not scored cases

definitions.alive_sets: Every grain is alive at t = 0 and no grain returns, so the alive set at step s is every grain whose extinction step is absent or later than s. Each evaluation row stores the two counts and the grains alive in only one of the two runs.
definitions.criterion_ratio: field_ratio / a(s); criterion (iv) requires at most 1
definitions.extinction_step: the first step s >= 1 with V_k(s) <= 1e-6; any later rise above 1e-6 is a return
definitions.field_error: E_TV(s) = (1 / 2n^3) sum over voxels and phases of |phi_model - phi_ref|
definitions.grain_volume: V_k(s), the double-precision sum of phase field k over all voxels at step s
definitions.label_disagreement: percentage of voxels whose argmax grain label differs between model and reference
definitions.persistence: the initial field held fixed, scored against the reference at step s

mean_radius_slope.definition: Rbar = (3 n^3 / (4 pi N_alive))^(1/3); slope of Rbar^2 - Rbar_0^2 against t from a linear least-squares fit over 40 <= t <= 135, every step

size_distribution.definition: u = R / <R>, R the equivalent-sphere radius of each grain from its diffuse volume, grains of at most one voxel excluded, normalized by the mean radius of its own microstructure, then pooled over microstructures 1 to 3; the log-normal width is the standard deviation of log u; the KS distance is the two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic between model and reference

derived_statistics.source: computed by scripts/package_phaselocal_transfer.py from the release-asset volume tables and label arrays; re-derived by scripts/verify_phaselocal_transfer.py --asset-root. Descriptive; no acceptance criterion depends on these values.

training.initial_labels_note: regenerated from the recorded generation parameters of the periodic Voronoi construction; the training program rebuilt these fields at the start of the run and did not save them, so no stored copy exists to compare with
training.recipe: Four autonomous trajectories, one per initial microstructure, advance ten learned steps each without keeping their computational graphs, followed by twenty Adam updates; each trajectory restarts from its initial field after 3,000 steps. A first-in first-out buffer of capacity 240 starts with the four initial fields and receives each trajectory's state every ten steps, so it holds only initial fields and states generated by the model itself. Every update draws six crops (20^3 interior, 3-cell halo) from uniformly chosen buffer states at uniform periodic offsets. The target is one application of the reference map to the sampled state, computed without gradient and restricted to the interior; the loss is the mean over crops and interior voxels of the squared difference summed over phases, without time-step scaling. Adam, cosine learning rate from 1e-3 to 1e-4, 28,200 updates in 1,410 cycles. Convolution weights are initialized uniformly on +/-(27 c_in)^(-1/2), the third convolution multiplied by 0.1.
training.reproducibility: recipe level; training is not bitwise reproducible across software builds
